emergency.smsBody: I need emergency support. My district and nearest landmark are:
emergency.step.call: Call {{number}} immediately and clearly state your district, city, and nearest landmark.
emergency.step.breathing: Check breathing. If it has stopped, gently tilt the head back to open the airway.
emergency.step.position: If the person is unconscious but breathing, turn them onto their side to reduce choking risk.
emergency.step.stay: Stay with the person until help arrives. Keep them warm; do not give alcohol or food or induce vomiting.
help.title: A safe place to ask for help
help.intro: Whatever you or someone close to you is facing, you do not have to face it in silence or shame. Choose a pathway below or speak privately with the assistant.
help.riskDescription: A private questionnaire that does not diagnose, with guidance for different levels of concern and emergencies.
help.stopTitle: I want to stop using substances
help.stopDescription: Taking this step takes courage. Find compassionate guidance, safe medical advice, and local clinics without judgment.
help.friendTitle: I am worried about a friend or family member
help.friendDescription: Learn how to talk without blame, set healthy boundaries, and connect someone with trusted counselling.
help.urgentDescription: Learn to recognize dangerous symptoms and withdrawal risks, and when to call {{number}} for emergency medical help.
help.urgentPrompt: What urgent medical warning signs and withdrawal risks should I watch for?
help.supportDescription: Find verified hospitals and support centres across Sri Lanka, with phone numbers and service information.
help.emergencyDescription: If someone is unresponsive, having a seizure, has severe chest pain, or is struggling to breathe, call emergency medical help immediately. For confidential advice about substance use, contact the national helpline.
donate.title: Support prevention and recovery in Sri Lanka
donate.intro: Review what has been verified, what is still being prepared, and how to request confirmed donation details before sending money.
donate.sectionDescription: We do not publish unverified bank details, approval claims, spending totals, or impact figures. The project team must verify and publish supporting records before accepting donations.
donate.purposeDescription: The project focuses on prevention education, community outreach, and maintaining support resources. No allocation percentages or outcomes are claimed here.
donate.approvalsDescription: Government or non-profit approval documents and an authorized payment account are not published here. This website is not proof of approval.
donate.auditDescription: No independently reviewed public spending or annual donation report is available here yet. Verified totals will only be published with an approved source.
donate.privacyDescription: Anonymous donations are not available while payment intake is paused. Never email payment credentials or sensitive banking information.
donate.verifyNotice: Confirm current instructions with the organizing team before making a contribution.
donate.unavailable: Online donations are not available yet
donate.formDescription: This website does not have a verified payment service or approved payment instructions. No payment will be taken here, and this form will not create a receipt.
donate.securityNotice: Do not send money using unverified bank details or payment links. Never email card numbers, security codes, passwords, or banking codes.
donate.askTeam: Ask the project team for verified information
home.heroDescription: Knowledge builds awareness. Compassionate support opens possibilities. Together, we can help people move forward.
home.preventDescription: Give students, families, and communities reliable knowledge to understand pressure and prevent harmful substance use.
home.supportDescription: Offer caring, private guidance and step-by-step ways to find appropriate support.
home.connectDescription: Connect people with verified hospitals, public services, and community support across Sri Lanka.
home.realityParagraph1: Substance-related health concerns affect young people and families across Sri Lanka. Reliable information and timely support can help people make safer choices and seek care.
home.realityParagraph2: Stigma, fear, and difficulty finding trusted local information can stop people from seeking help. Respectful guidance can make it easier to reach appropriate care.
home.realityParagraph3: The Leo Club of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura created this resource to help young people and families ask questions safely, learn from reviewed information, and find local support.
home.callEmergency: If there is immediate danger, call emergency services.
home.wizardTitle: Not sure where to begin? Get guided support.
home.wizardDescription: If it is hard to know what to ask, answer a few guided questions to explore your concerns and local support options.
home.careTitle: Care and support services in Sri Lanka
home.careDescription: Explore verified public services, rehabilitation centres, and hospital mental-health services with contact information.
home.thalangamaDescription: Contact the centre to confirm current services and availability.
home.melMeduraDescription: Confidential counselling and support for individuals and families. Contact the centre to confirm current services.
home.mentalHealthDescription: Contact the service to confirm current mental-health support and availability.
home.openMap: Open the map and browse districts
home.donationDescription: Donations are paused while payment and reporting details are prepared. Check the donation page for current information; no unverified totals or bank details are shown.
